arStrings.szText: {c_important}Bone Spear{/c} makes the first enemy hit {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} seconds and breaks into {c_number}{SF_6}{/c} bone shards when destroyed, dealing {c_number}{payload:BONE_SHARD}{/c} damage each.

{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|%x|]{/c} more {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} damage and restores {c_number}[{SF_36}*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_36]){/c} after {c_important}Overpowering{/c}.

{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} has {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|%+|]{/c} more Critical Strike Chance. If its main projectile Critically Strikes, {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} more bone shards form upon expiration and you gain {c_number}[{SF_35}|%|]{/c} Maximum Essence for {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} seconds.
